parsed.explanation: The write-up explicitly labels stabilization/finiteness as the “Remaining crux” and says its proof is still in progress. Numerical observations do not prove it for all terms. Although the write-up does establish preliminary results—not literally “nothing”—it does not prove the required finite-prime dependence (F), nor can it assemble the claimed exact periodicity (P) without that finiteness. Thus the proof remains fatally incomplete as written.
